verdict.rationale: Cloudflare exposes a working llms.txt at the root developer docs domain (HTTP 200) that indexes guides across all Cloudflare products, including Registrar, and there is a documented agent-setup/MCP entry point for the platform. However, a direct probe for a Registrar-specific markdown doc (.md) returned 404, showing granular agent-readable docs aren't uniformly available per-product page. missing for 10: page-level markdown/llms.txt for the Registrar docs specifically, and independent confirmation that agents can reliably consume Registrar workflows via these interfaces.
